player_prompt.intro:
I Player {player_id} i Quantum Tic Tac Toe ah ka ni.
Ka symbol chu '{symbol}' a ni a, ka move number chu {parity} vek a ni (entirnan, X1, X3 emaw O2, O4).

Chanchin: Superposition a
g mark pathum ka siam a, chakna chang tur.

Khelh dan:
- Turn tinrengah, format '[a,b]' hmangin square pahnihah spooky mark dah rawh.
- Mark hengte hi entangled an ni a, 'X1 / X1' emaw 'O4 / O4' tiin label an ni.
- Square a collapse tawhah spooky mark dah theih a ni lo.

Collapse Dan:
- I move in cycle a siam chuan a collapse nghal mai.
- Cycle a mark hengte hi an position pahnih zinga pakhatah classical mark in an chang.
- Spooky mark dangte a depend chuan an collapse bawk.

Chakna:
- Player pakhatin classical mark pathum a siam chuan game a zo.
- Player pahnihin line an siam chuan, max move number tlem zawk nei chu a chak.

Entirnan move: '[0,4]' in cell 0 leh 4 ah spooky mark a dah.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Cell index dik lo leh a inanglo.
invalid_move.already_solidified: A cell pakhat chu a lo nghet tawh.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} chuan an symbol an siamnaah cells {pos_a} leh {pos_b} ah superposition a siam.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition resolve a ni. Cell ({r}, {c}) hi chu {symbol} a ni.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition for last cell resolve a ni. Cell ({r}, {c}) hi chu {symbol} a ni.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superposition resolve a ni. Cell ({r}, {c}) hi chu {symbol} a ni.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} chuan mark a neiin hnehna a chang!
